name: Create Drone
body:
School transmutation; Level sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a brass ball worth 5 gp)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect floating fine construct
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You instill power into the brass ball, turning it into a miniature attack construct. The drone attacks foes at a distance, as you direct it, dealing 1d8 force damage per hit, + 1 point per three caster levels (maximum +5 at 15th level). It strikes the opponent you designate, starting with one attack in the round the spell is cast and continuing each round thereafter on your turn. It uses your base attack bonus (possibly allowing it multiple attacks per round in subsequent rounds) plus your spellcasting ability modifier as its attack bonus. It strikes as a spell, not as a weapon, so for example, it can damage creatures that have damage reduction. As a force effect, it can strike incorporeal creatures without the reduction in damage associated with incorporeality. The drone always strikes from your direction. It does not get a flanking bonus or help a combatant get one. Your feats or combat actions do not affect the weapon. If the drone goes beyond the spell range, if it goes out of your sight, or if you are not directing it, it returns to you and hovers.

Each round after the first, you can use a move action to redirect the weapon to a new target, it can move up to 60 feet per round with a perfect fly maneuverability. If you do not, the drone continues to attack the previous round’s target. On any round that the drone switches targets, it gets one attack. Subsequent rounds of attacking that target allow the drone to make multiple attacks if your base attack bonus would allow it to.

The drone can be attacked and harmed by physical attacks. It has an AC of 24, cannot be caught flat-footed, has construct traits, a hardness of 9, and hit points equal to 5 times your caster level. If destroyed, the spell ends.

If an attacked creature has Spell Resistance, you make a caster level check (1d20 + caster level) against that Spell Resistance the first time the drone strikes it. If the drone is successfully resisted, it is unable to attack it for the remainder of the duration.
